case.name: Snoqualmie River, Snoqualmie to Carnation — January 2009 with observed tributaries
case.purpose: Post-baseline forcing diagnostic using independently observed Raging and Tolt River hydrographs; downstream observations remain scoring-only.

sources.provider: U.S. Geological Survey Water Data APIs
U.S. Geological Survey Water Data APIs

internal_sources.name: Raging River near Fall City
internal_sources.station_source: USGS NLDI downstream network intersection, expressed as the same fraction of the configured routed reach length
internal_sources.travel_time_assumption: No gauge-to-confluence shift; retained as a documented timing uncertainty

internal_sources.name: Tolt River near Carnation
internal_sources.station_source: USGS NLDI downstream network intersection, expressed as the same fraction of the configured routed reach length
internal_sources.travel_time_assumption: No gauge-to-confluence shift; retained as a documented timing uncertainty

reach.roughness_origin: A priori SI Manning n 0.035 divided by 60; not fitted
reach.slope_source: Difference between published NAVD88 gage datums divided by routed length; screening proxy only

reach_context.forcing_limitation: Raging and Tolt River gauge flow is supplied; ungauged runoff, direct rainfall, lowland floodplain exchange, and local controls remain omitted.
